_comment: SYNTHETIC. Hand-written for plan section 3.8 and risk R14: the under-delivery case. The response carries no `extra_usage` key at all, while `spend` reports an enabled, non-zero balance. agentctl reads credits from `extra_usage` only (decision D-006), so the column reads `n/a` — and this is the one body that must produce a warning saying so, because otherwise a user with credits would be told nothing and see nothing. Not captured from the API.

spend.disclaimer: Usage credits cover you when you hit your plan limits. [Learn more](https://support.claude.com/articles/12429409)
